boundaries.name: poseidon-hash-callback
boundaries.obligation: `PoseidonHashOut::hash_inputs_u64` and `PoseidonLeafableHasher::two_to_one` are opaque functions here. No collision resistance, preimage resistance or injectivity is assumed; every statement that needs two digests to differ carries that as an explicit premise on the compared pair.

boundaries.name: native-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Native `to_u64_vec` word lists and in-circuit `to_vec` target lists are represented by the same Lean lists. That the plonky2 builder emits exactly those wires, and that `builder.constant`/`range_check` behave as modelled, is not proved.

boundaries.name: field-and-range-discipline
boundaries.obligation: `Nat` stands for Goldilocks field elements, `u32` limbs and `u64` values. Canonicality and range checks appear as explicit hypotheses, never as type invariants; field arithmetic is not modelled.

boundaries.name: backing-tree-model-import
boundaries.obligation: Merkle-tree behaviour is taken from the registered `Zkp.Implementation.SparseTrees` and `Zkp.Implementation.IndexedMerkleTree` models of `src/utils/trees/`, which are themselves handwritten models of that Rust code, not refinements of it.

boundaries.name: constants-transcription
boundaries.obligation: Every pinned height is taken from the registered `Zkp.Implementation.UtilGadgets` transcription of `src/constants.rs`. That the transcription matches the Rust constants is checked by review, not by a proof.

boundaries.name: panics
boundaries.obligation: Rust `assert!`/`unwrap`/index panics (`IncrementalMerkleTree::push` capacity, `HashMap` indexing) are modelled as explicit error or outcome values; the partially mutated state a real panic leaves behind is not modelled.
